text: Freeze bounded learned recipe eyes4s.training-mean-cosine-response/1: statistical unit is a trial; input maps are normalized Mass values on one nominal grid; equal trial weights form Mass.mean from training rows only; feature x_i = cosine(m_i, mean_train), response y_i = beta*x_i fitted by native no-intercept QR at fixed rank tolerance. Explicit split-group labels declare the independence unit; rows sharing held-out match groups are excluded from training and retained in exclusions. No response-weighted templates, PCA/CORAL/CCA or implicit normalization. Record training rows/digest, split unit, response unit, recipe identity, mean and slope; held-out map/response perturbations must preserve learned state. This is a named native recipe, not asserted equivalence to an eyesim learned transform.
